title: Oceania Cruises® Showcases 2027 and 2028 European Voyages
body_markdown:
*Destination-Rich Voyages Span Northern Europe, the Mediterranean, Adriatic and Aegean, Including the First-Ever Full Winter Season in the Mediterranean aboard Oceania Allura* *™*


MIAMI


, Oct. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Oceania Cruises](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786019-1&h=559312258&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2F&a=Oceania+Cruises) ®, the world's leading destination- and culinary-focused luxury cruise line, has unveiled an expansive collection of 2027 and 2028 European voyages, offering guests more opportunities to explore Europe through thoughtfully crafted itineraries, local traditions and exceptional culinary experiences.


The line will mark a milestone with its first-ever full winter season of voyages in the Mediterranean aboard *Oceania Allura* ™, featuring 17 voyages spanning November 2027 through March 2028. Ranging from nine to 26 days and sailing between destinations including Barcelona, Rome, Athens and Istanbul, these shoulder-season voyages offer a fresh perspective on some of the region's most iconic cities, coastal towns and islands. Guests can experience a slower pace and cooler temperatures while exploring ashore, from quiet piazzas and artisan markets to leisurely afternoons immersed in local culture.


"Europe is one of the most beloved cruise regions, and we are thrilled to offer our guests year-round opportunities to sail with us," said Jason Montague, Chief Luxury Officer of Oceania Cruises. "With more ways to explore the continent, from weeklong escapes to longer, unhurried journeys across the seasons, we're giving guests the freedom to experience Europe entirely on their own terms."


Each itinerary is designed to offer guests the chance to explore new places and rediscover favorites through a new lens, with hundreds of shore excursion choices. Oceania Cruises is renowned for its imaginative itineraries which pair landmark capitals such as Rome, Paris, London, Barcelona and Istanbul with lesser-explored gems including Golfo Aranci in Sardinia, Gythion and Skiathos in Greece, Kotor in Montenegro, Taranto in Puglia, and Çanakkale, gateway to the ancient ruins of Troy. Overnight and extended stays in destinations such as Bordeaux, Hamburg and Florence/Pisa/Tuscany give guests more time to settle into each place and experience it more fully.


Across every voyage, guests can take advantage of small-group shore excursions and onboard experiences designed to bring the region's culture, history and traditions to life. From exploring the vineyards of the Iberian Peninsula and wandering medieval cobbled streets in Northern Europe to uncovering ancient sites across Greece and Turkey, guests can connect more deeply with each destination.


On board the line's small, luxurious ships, gastronomy sits at the heart of every voyage. Guests can experience The Finest Cuisine at Sea *®* not only on board but woven into each destination. In the Adriatic and Ionian, guests can join one of Oceania Cruises' signature Culinary Discovery Tours™ *,* exploring local markets and family-run producers before sitting down to a chef-led lunch that showcases the region's finest ingredients. Throughout Europe, local flavors and culinary traditions enrich every journey, both ashore and on board.


**Highlighted 2027-28 Europe Voyages:**


- [Atlantic Wine Trails](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786019-1&h=4238454406&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FINS270424%2F&a=Atlantic+Wine+Trails) : 10-day voyage from Lisbon to London, departing April 24, 2027, aboard *Oceania Insignia* ™. Tracing the wine regions and coastlines of the Iberian Peninsula and France, this voyage calls on Oporto, La Coruña, Bilbao, Biarritz and features an overnight stay in Bordeaux before visiting Saint-Malo and St. Peter Port in Guernsey. The itinerary pairs celebrated wine country with charming ports along the western coasts of Europe.


- [Mysteries of History](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786019-1&h=3416978252&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FSIR270524%2F&a=Mysteries+of+History) : 9-day voyage from Rome to Istanbul, departing May 24, 2027, aboard *Oceania Sirena* ™. This in-depth journey through Italy, Greece and Turkey calls on Salerno, Messina and Syracuse before Katakolon, Gythion, Mykonos and Skiathos in Greece, and finally, Çanakkale, the gateway to ancient Troy. The voyage traces centuries of history across three countries before concluding in Istanbul.


- [Glacial Adventure](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786019-1&h=2727082091&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FMNA270726%2F&a=Glacial+Adventure) : 13-day voyage from Copenhagen to Reykjavik, departing July 26, 2027, aboard *Oceania Marina* ™. This Northern Europe voyage calls at Gothenburg and Oslo before tracing Norway's coast through Kristiansand, Stavanger, Eidfjord and Måløy, continuing to Tórshavn and then exploring Djupivogur, Seydisfjordur and Akureyri in Iceland before concluding in Reykjavik. The itinerary brings together Scandinavian capitals, Norway's dramatic fjords and Iceland's remote coastal landscapes.


- [Croissants & Cannoli](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786019-1&h=2318491751&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FNAU270916%2F&a=Croissants+%26+Cannoli) : 10-day voyage from Barcelona to Rome, departing September 16, 2027, aboard *Oceania Nautica* ™. A leisurely exploration of the Western Mediterranean, this voyage calls on Sète, Marseille and Monte Carlo before continuing to Florence/Pisa/Tuscany, Bastia, Olbia/Porto Cervo, Messina and Salerno. The itinerary pairs the French Riviera with Corsica, Sardinia and southern Italy before concluding in Rome.


- [Warm Winter Wonderland](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786019-1&h=2493862986&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FALU271208%2F&a=Warm+Winter+Wonderland) : 12-day voyage from Athens to Barcelona, departing December 8, 2027, aboard *Oceania Allura* . This voyage journeys to Limassol, Rhodes and Ephesus before calling at Heraklion and Katakolon. From Valletta, cross to Trapani and Cagliari and then visit Mahón and Palma de Mallorca en route to Barcelona. Blending ancient sites and picturesque islands, this itinerary explores from Cyprus and the Aegean to the Balearic Islands.


- [Iconic Art & Architecture](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786019-1&h=1493309884&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FALU280131%2F&a=Iconic+Art+%26+Architecture) : 9-day voyage roundtrip from Rome, departing January 31, 2028, aboard *Oceania Allura* . Set off from the Eternal City to Porto Torres and Palma de Mallorca before crossing to Tunis, then visiting Trapani, Valletta, Messina and Salerno before returning to Rome. The itinerary explores the Mediterranean's artistic and architectural legacy.


For more information on Oceania Cruises' collection of small, luxurious ships and curated global itineraries, visit OceaniaCruises.com or call Oceania Cruises at 855-OCEANIA, or speak with a professional travel advisor.


**About Oceania Cruises®** Oceania Cruises® is the world's leading destination- and culinary-focused luxury cruise line, celebrated for its port-rich voyages and authentic cultural and culinary experiences. The line's intimate, luxurious ships feature an adults-only environment, with a high proportion of spacious rooms and suites, calling on more than 600 marquee and boutique ports in more than 100 countries across seven continents, with destination-intensive itineraries ranging from seven to 180 days. Aboard the designer-inspired ships, guests enjoy personalized service supported by a strong crew-to-guest ratio, alongside *The Finest Cuisine at Sea®* , prepared by one of the highest chef-to-guest ratios at sea. Oceania Cruises® is also recognized as one of the world's most awarded cruise lines, with accolades spanning luxury, dining, service and destination experiences. Oceania Cruises® has five Sonata Class ships on order scheduled for delivery in 2027, 2029, 2032, 2035 and 2037. Oceania Cruises® is a wholly owned subsidiary of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH).
